answer: Put every identity to work live on the same shared meadow: at unpredictable moments each is given a small, unique patch to tend alongside strangers, and its patch borders theirs, so a good move must fit what neighbours just did. A single agent watches its jade marker, reacts in time, and keeps its strip coherent. One operator juggling clones cannot be present on every patch at once: switches leave gaps, late or opal-pale copies, and clashing edits where two masks tried to occupy the same moment, so a crowd must pay a crowd's worth of attention to pass as one.
